Calculating.name: Calculating
Calculating.description:
♟️ Every move is three moves ahead. You plan, you wait and you strike when the odds are yours.

🧮 You read a fight or a deal like a board and find the weak square.
⚠️ Chaos ruins plans, and you are slow when there is no time to think.
⚠️ People feel they are being measured, and they are right.
🔀 If you are also Hot-Blooded, the plan holds until someone makes it personal.

📈 Grants: Combat Tactics +5
Calculating.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is calculating: they plan several moves ahead, wait for the odds to favor them and read fights and deals like a board. Weakness: chaos and surprises ruin plans, they are slow when there is no time to think, and people sense they are being measured. If the character is also Hot-Blooded, the plan holds until someone makes it personal. The narrator shows the board honestly, including what the character cannot know; the moves are the player's decision.
